tagline: Soft sherpa-pile lining and a raised rim, for the dog who always finds an edge.
lead: Your dog gets a soft, sherpa-lined nest to tuck into, with a raised rim to curl against.
value: Five sizes from XS to XL let you match the footprint to how your dog curls up, and the cover washes at 30°C.
intro: Dormouse is a nest dog bed with a sherpa-pile lining, a raised rim around the resting area and a removable zipped cover that washes at 30°C, in five sizes from XS to XL.
points: A soft, tactile surface to settle into.
The raised rim surrounds the resting area.
XS to XL, for a closer match to your dog's curled-up size.
The zipped cover comes off and washes at 30°C.
best_for: Dogs who tuck themselves in and lean against the rim of their bed.
fit_note: Measure your dog lying down, nose to base of tail, and allow 15–20cm extra, then compare with the space inside the rim. Ask us for the Small's measurements before ordering.
care: Wash the removable cover at 30°C, following the sewn-in label, and air-dry it fully before refitting.
seo_title: Sherpa-Lined Nest Dog Bed, XS to XL | Snoozly
seo_description: A sherpa-lined nest dog bed with a raised rim for dogs who curl up against an edge. Five sizes, XS to XL, and a zipped cover that washes at 30°C.
